changes: Split the rendering stack to minimize if checks for editor vs sim
Fixed celestial children was not being updated resulting in weird offsets when offset as seen in the mars video I made. Jamie also fixed this at the same time.

Added duplicate command that duplicates the provided vehicle at the same position, to be used for testing for vehicles, which I used to complete the first near vehicle rendezvous in KSA. Physics seems excellent even at significant warp.
Fixed load of patched conics not populating patch orbit points for rendering.
Further progress towards multi-window rendering from my branch
Some objects now correctly render to secondary windows
Basic camera controls for secondary windows
In-progress console support on secondary windows with console commands affecting objects in that window

Fixed thrusters and engines for duplicated rocket instance would be shared visually. Simple fix to just clone the elements. Now when duplicating a vehicle, it will initialize its own thruster and engine instances.
Support for sun bloom/flares on multiple viewports
Enable Vulkan portability features for Mac

Add "MutableComparisonSamplers" Vulkan support for Mac. Shadows need to use a mutable comparison sampler, but MoltenVK on Mac throws a Vulkan error if the feature is not enabled in the DeviceFeatures.
Enable triangle fan support for Mac, as Vulkan errors are thrown on Mac if this is not enabled.
Second pass on snapping to properly handle rotation.
fixed same SOI transfers somehow dropped off the transfer planner planet list.+
Fixed bug in Follow that caused the camera to be briefly set to an invalid rotation every time the camera Follow was set.
Removed vehicles that currently don't have meshes, will add back some test vehicles with meshes instead.

Added VesselNext and VesselPrevious input actions to allow moving between vessels. Note this instantly moves through every vessel in the game, a good demonstration of the power of the seamlessness in the game. Every vessel can be instantly moved between with no loading.
Enable godrays by default. Planetary shadows are now more stable and godray performance has been optimized making it safe to enable by default
Fix resampling artifacts on godrays due to using point filtering with reprojection
Fix recent changes causing noisy appearance on clouds due to not passing the frame number correctly
Fix exhaust noise animation breaking when a lot of time has passed: Keep exhaust animation time in low float exponents
Added automatic navball mode switch in addition to camera mode switch as the vehicle goes from surface to low orbit to high orbit.
Adjusted vehicle clone function to preserve last kinematic states.
Removed unnecessary cast in Celestial line drawing.

Moved orbit visibility from the Orbit up to the Celestial. This matches the UI and (I think) player intuition about how orbit visibility should work more closely. It also gets rid of cases where orbits deep inside e.g. flight plans can be unexpectedly visible or invisible.
in the flares the new bent orbs were overpowering the ghost orbs, so new multipliers were added to control them separately
new debug options to control the orb powers separately
new defaults added to normalize both the new multipliers and the overall game settings multiplier
some cleanup of unused variables/buffers
Refactored the CommandBufferPool class to now respect the number of in-flight frames and to no longer stall the CPU waiting for compute work to complete.
Removed the fence for the dedicated compute command buffer pool. Compute commands are now recorded after the graphics fence.
Call OnPreRender() recursively so that all children are fully visited. This fixes another case of orbit lines not being drawn when expected.
Consolidated all navball data into a single struct and we now update it coherently once per frame.
We now display surface speed and radar altitude when in SURF mode.
Switch to Roll/Pitch/Yaw (rather than Roll/Yaw/Pitch) in SURF mode. This matches the aircraft convention of making heading the primary axis, with pitch being +/- 90.
Zero out velocity when landed.
Added a spherical drag model to Vehicles. This is extremely basic for now but serves to make launch and landing at Earth way more realistic.
Reduced Rayleigh scattering scale height at Earth from 16 km to 8.5 km to approximate the real value. May need to split the physics and rendering values at some point.
Added PressureReference and DensityReference as XML quantities.
More work on making the transform UI nicer for parts
Remove Vulkan Device layers commented out code The device layers are ignored by the Vulkan spec, so the commented out code doesn't need to be there.
Increased the poly count of the circle mesh
Fixed some snapping problems with parent rotations being only half taken into account
Changed camera movement animation to only occur when vehicle is the same selected, so that selecting camera of next vehicle does not animate through stuff.
Added first pass of additional vehicle model (Gemini) for testing and asset pipeline tests. No thrusters added.

Fixed a very stupid bug done by me that has been here for a very long time.... since I begun patched conics work. That was resulting in completely invalid patch start times that got worse as time progresses, and was fundamentally worse if you had several encounters.
Fixed the mouse position being in viewport space rather than screen space for checking against the maneuver gizmo handles.
Removed unnecessary computation related to surface mode navball rates.
Fixed several more (all?) instances of mouse position being in viewport space instead of screen space.
Separate visual and physical settings for the atmosphere
Set physical atmosphere settings for all the atmosphericBodies
Rename 'scatteringEditor' console command to 'atmosphere'
Fix PressureReference.SetValue not working when values are provided in atm
Use shadow bias on godrays
Added second pass on Gemini sample vehicle. Included all attitude and translation thruster setup. Adapted model to better represent actual placement and direction of thrusters.
Added a simple edit mode to prepare xml for thruster placement.
Added Gemini 7 to EarthSystem configuration for testing.
Fixed Gemini control assignments for Translation Left and Right was flipped.
Fixed naming of Gemini Transation was inconsistent.
